pairs.why: B's lasso is built like a real coiled rope, with a calmer, more matte finish, while A is a chunky, glossy, foam-toy coil; A does match the chunkiness of the real scarf, so this is close.
B's rope has a muddled build, a coil fused to a separate ring like spectacles, while A's chunky coil reads as one believable object in the real cards' smooth, soft finish.
B is built like a real locomotive, with boiler bands, piping and a tender, and has a calmer, less toy-like finish, much like the bus and bike; A is a simplified, chunky, glossy toy.
A has a softer, painterly matte finish, calmer navy and red colour, and believable locomotive parts (cowcatcher, coal tender), so it is closer to the real bus and bike than B's darker, harder render.
A sits in a full scene like the real cards and is built like a real engine, while B is a glossy flat side profile on an empty gradient with a toy-like saturated red cab.
